proposalConnectionPolicy.reason: The v1 public proposal connection was closed while idle before its second five-minute snapshot. V2 opens one bounded connection for each two-quote cycle instead of retrying an ambiguous request.

inferenceBoundary: Recorded ticks and indicative public proposals may support capability, cadence, and price-path diagnostics only. They are not fills, sales, settlements, or historical executable profitability evidence.
stoppingConditions: Stop proposal capture after 12 point quotes.
Stop the tick branch after more than four reconnects.
Never authenticate, buy, sell, cancel, or retry an order.
